record.question: The mean, median and mode of group of 75 observations are 27, 29 and 34 respectively. Later, it was found that one observation was misread as 43 instead of the correct one of 63. Then what are the values of the mean, median and mode after correction?
record.explanation: Misreading 43 as 63 raises the total by 20, so the corrected mean is (75×27 + 20)/75 = 2045/75 ≈ 27.26. Only the first option keeps the corrected mean, since the others leave it at 27; the mode of 34 is unchanged. The corrected median of 29.51 was not independently re-derived.
